selection.summary: Investigated Svelte issue #12333: `{@html}` and `` hydration behavior. Confirmed the runtime already keeps server values for `{@html}` blocks and for `src`/`srcset`/`href` attributes during hydration, emitting dev-mode `hydration_html_changed` / `hydration_attribute_changed` warnings (attributes.js `check_src_in_dev_hydration` at lines 87-98 and 379-388; warnings.js lines 14-19). Patch: (1) documented this behavior in the `{@html}` section of documentation/docs/02-template-syntax/02-basic-markup.md; (2) extended packages/svelte/tests/hydration/samples/ignore-mismatched-href with an `` case asserting the server value is kept and the `src` mismatch warning fires. Note: tooling only permits edits to existing tracked files (no new-file creation) and tests could not be executed here, so the img case lives in the existing sample rather than a new sample directory.
